title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
titleHi: खिलौनों की सुरक्षा — भाग 1: यांत्रिक और भौतिक गुणों से संबंधित सुरक्षा पहलू
qcoOrder: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (Ministry of Commerce & Industry)
scope: Applies to all toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age. Specifies criteria for physical features including sharp edges, points, small parts (choking hazard for under 36 months), cords, and impact resistance.
scopeHi: यह मानक 14 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों के लिए बने सभी खिलौनों पर लागू होता है और नुकीले किनारों, छोटे हिस्सों (दम घुटने का खतरा) और मजबूती से संबंधित सुरक्षा मानदंड तय करता है।

keyTests.name: Small Parts Cylinder Choking Test
keyTests.description: Components must not fit entirely inside standard test cylinder (31.7 mm dia).
keyTests.parameterLimit: No detachable small parts for toys intended for children under 3 years

keyTests.name: Sharp Edge & Sharp Point Test
keyTests.parameterLimit: Zero hazardous sharp edges or sharp points

keyTests.name: Drop and Impact Test
keyTests.description: Toys dropped 5 times from 850 mm onto concrete slab.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Must not crack, shatter into sharp splinters, or release small parts

markingRequirements: Toys and packaging must display the ISI mark, CM/L number, manufacturer identity, age grading, warning symbols, and maximum battery specifications.
consumerTips: Every toy sold in Indian retail or online must have the ISI mark; importing or selling non-ISI toys is illegal in India.
Check age recommendation labels carefully, especially for toys containing button batteries or small magnets.
industryGuidelines: Chemical compliance under IS 9873 (Part 3) for heavy metal migration is mandatory alongside Part 1.

clauses.title: Small Parts for Children Under 36 Months
clauses.content: Toys intended for children under 36 months of age, and their removable components, shall not fit entirely inside the small parts cylinder.
clauses.contentHi: 36 महीने से कम उम्र के बच्चों के खिलौने टेस्ट सिलेंडर में पूरी तरह नहीं समाने चाहिए।

title: Safety of Electric Toys
scope: Covers the safety requirements for electric toys operating from batteries, transformers, or solar cells with rated supply voltage not exceeding 24 V DC/AC.
scopeHi: यह 24V से कम वोल्टेज पर बैटरी या अडैप्टर से चलने वाले इलेक्ट्रॉनिक और रिमोट कंट्रोल खिलौनों की सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं को कवर करता है।

keyTests.name: Operating Voltage Limit Test
keyTests.description: Verifies toy cannot be connected to supplies higher than 24V extra-low voltage.

keyTests.name: Thermal Heating & Battery Compartment Test
keyTests.description: Toy operated under locked rotor/short-circuit conditions.

markingRequirements: ISI mark, CM/L number, battery type/polarity indication, rated voltage.
consumerTips: Never mix old and new batteries in electric toys.
Check that battery compartments require a tool to open.
industryGuidelines: Must comply concurrently with IS 9873 Parts 1, 2, 3 and IS 15644.

clauses.title: Supply Voltage Constraints
clauses.content: Electric toys shall not be powered by voltages exceeding 24 V DC or AC RMS.
clauses.contentHi: इलेक्ट्रिक खिलौनों को 24 V DC या AC से अधिक वोल्टेज पर नहीं चलाया जाएगा।

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
titleHi: पैकेज्ड पेयजल (प्राकृतिक खनिज जल के अलावा) — विशिष्‍टि
qcoOrder: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations & Mandatory BIS Certification
scope: Prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and testing for packaged drinking water filled in hermetically sealed food-grade containers of various capacities (pouches, bottles, jars, cans).
scopeHi: यह मानक सीलबंद बोतलों और जार में बेचे जाने वाले पैकेज्ड पीने के पानी के भौतिक, रासायनिक और माइक्रोबायोलॉजिकल सुरक्षा मानकों को निर्धारित करता है।

keyTests.name: Microbiological Sterility Testing
keyTests.description: Tests for Total Coliforms, E. coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Yeast & Mould.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Zero (Absent) per 250 ml sample for all pathogen classes

keyTests.name: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS)
keyTests.description: Measures dissolved mineral content post-filtration and mineralization.

keyTests.name: Pesticide Residues (Individual & Total)
keyTests.description: GC-MS testing for organochlorine, organophosphorus pesticides.
keyTests.parameterLimit: Individual pesticide < 0.0001 mg/l (0.1 ppb); Total < 0.0005 mg/l (0.5 ppb)

markingRequirements: Container must clearly display the ISI Mark, CM/L License Number, PACKAGED DRINKING WATER in bold caps, FSSAI License Number, Date of packaging, Best Before Date, Batch/Lot number, and Net Quantity.
consumerTips: Always check for the holographic/tamper-evident seal and valid ISI mark before buying water bottles.
Check that the label states Packaged Drinking Water with an active FSSAI and BIS CM/L license number.
industryGuidelines: Every bottling facility must have an in-house NABL-aligned laboratory with a qualified microbiologist and chemist.

clauses.title: Permissible Processing Treatments
clauses.content: Water shall be derived from potable surface/ground source and treated by filtration, demineralization/reverse osmosis, and disinfected via ozonation or UV irradiation.
clauses.contentHi: पानी को आरओ, ओजोनेशन और यूवी विकिरण जैसी स्वीकृत वैज्ञानिक प्रक्रियाओं से रोगाणुमुक्त और शुद्ध किया जाना चाहिए।

title: Drinking Water — Specification
qcoOrder: Uniform Water Quality Standards across Municipal & Jal Jeevan Mission utilities
scope: Prescribes the acceptable and permissible requirements and limits for essential characteristics and desirable parameters of drinking water supplied through municipal piped networks and rural water supply schemes.
scopeHi: यह मानक नगर पालिकाओं और जल जीवन मिशन द्वारा आपूर्ति किए जाने वाले नल के पीने के पानी की गुणवत्ता और शुद्धता के मापदंड तय करता है।

keyTests.name: Fluoride and Nitrate
keyTests.parameterLimit: Fluoride: 1.0 mg/l max; Nitrate: 45 mg/l max

markingRequirements: Used for laboratory compliance certification reports and municipal water audits.
consumerTips: If your tap water TDS is below 300 mg/L with normal pH, simple UV/UF filtration is adequate without heavy RO water waste.
industryGuidelines: Baseline standard for water treatment plants across Jal Jeevan Mission.

clauses.title: Bacteriological Quality
clauses.content: Water shall not contain E. coli or thermotolerant coliform bacteria in any 100 ml sample.
clauses.contentHi: किसी भी 100 मिलीलीटर नमूने में ई. कोलाई बैक्टीरिया नहीं होना चाहिए।

title: Reverse Osmosis (RO) Based Point-of-Use Water Treatment Systems — Specification
titleHi: रिवर्स ऑस्मोसिस (आरओ) आधारित वाटर प्यूरीफायर सिस्टम — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Prescribes requirements for residential point-of-use RO water purifiers, mandating minimum water recovery rates, TDS reduction efficiency, and total microbiological safety.
scopeHi: यह घरेलू आरओ वाटर प्यूरिफायर में पानी की बर्बादी रोकने (न्यूनतम 40%-60% रिकवरी) और रोगाणु शुद्धिकरण के मानकों को अनिवार्य करता है।

keyTests.name: Water Recovery Efficiency Test
keyTests.description: Ratio of permeate pure water to feed.

markingRequirements: ISI mark with CM/L number, declared water recovery percentage, input TDS range.
consumerTips: Look for IS 16240 ISI mark to ensure your RO purifier does not excessively waste water.
industryGuidelines: RO reject water discharge must be labeled with recommended recycling uses.

clauses.title: Water Recovery Ratio
clauses.content: RO systems shall achieve minimum product water recovery ≥ 40%.
clauses.contentHi: आरओ प्रणालियों को कम से कम 40% जल रिकवरी दक्षता हासिल करनी होगी।
